saw_lines: Shoppers replace bedsheets when a set wears thin or shrinks, then compare sizes and set counts before they pay.
So the sale is won at the offer and proof line, because comparing buyers need a reason to pick you now.
Your site offers 25% off on all dohars, yet 0 of 22 ads mention it, so put that offer in the first line of three new ads.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 28 Oct 2026
points: The site offers 25% off on all dohars, yet 0 of 22 ads mention percent off, so a new buyer has no reason to act today. Put that offer in the first line of three new ads and on the creative.
None of your 26 live ads shows a proof number, so a buyer comparing sheets has nothing concrete to trust. Collect one real figure, a review count or orders shipped, and lead the next batch with it.

2 of your 22 copy ads are creator posts run from the brand page, which hides who is speaking. Whitelist both from the creator account, then cut three variations of each so the real voice leads the next batch.

6 of your 22 copy ads open on “give your bedroom an instant”, while the other 16 spread across nine more openers. Test two new angles against that opener, one on price and one on fit, as fresh opening lines.

ads_1: Dohar offer creative, 25% off in line one, replacing the makeover opener
